description: Local fallback catalog for nominal cartridge yield. This catalog is tuned for mixed compatible/refilled cartridge usage instead of pure OEM values. OEM values are kept for reference; local/refill/compatible values are used by CARTRIDGE_YIELD_MODE.
matching_notes: A match may use cartridge_contains, model_contains, or both.
If your printer reports only generic names like Black Toner, add a model_contains rule for that printer model.
auto_learn and shared_profile always have higher priority than this catalog.
